prompt:

REAL transparent RGBA background behind each character and between cells. Landscape4:3 sheet, high resolution for384pixel output cells.

Strong expressive black ink outlines, angular purposeful shapes, two-tone cel shadows, vivid controlled hero accents on a dark violet/steel/petrol palette, visible Ben-Day halftone clusters and occasional dry ink.
